messages:
mike_eng: Heads-up: draft internal blurb for tomorrow's rollout. PTAL — need pin timing and rollback lane confirmed. /cc @kavita_pm @nate_writer

kavita_pm: Dropping suggested copy below. Keep short, link to docs. :eyes:

nate_writer: small nit on the first line, suggest "improved inference stability" -> "stability and latency improvements"

mike_eng: updated. here's the blurb:
```
Tomorrow 09:00 PDT: Redwood API model routing update (v2.3.0). Expected improvements: 12–30% median token latency reduction and improved fallback behavior. No customer action required. Rollout window: 09:00–11:00 PDT. If you see >5% error rate, rollback to v2.2.9 via the pinning dashboard.
```

ops_oncall: Ops plan: canary 5% for first 20m, then 25% for 20m, full at ~09:50 if metrics look good. Watchers: @ops_oncall, @sarah_sre. Key metrics to watch: 95p latency, error rate, token throughput.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary -> v2.3.0 (5%). ETA: 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z.

sarah_sre: i'll be on rotation and will watch canary. will give green at ~09:25 if stable.

mike_eng: Who's doing the internal publish once canary is green? Kavita / Nate?

kavita_pm: I can publish the internal brief to #all-hands and update the release notes page after canary green. Nate will handle the short broadcast snippets.

nate_writer: prepping 3 short snippets for #general, email, and ops pager. Will include rollback instructions and link to the pin dashboard.

mike_eng: final ask — confirm rollback command snippet for ops runbook. want a single-liner we can paste into the brief.

sarah_sre: Runbook snippet below (tested):
```
# rollback to pinned v2.2.9
redwood pin set --model text-gen --version v2.2.9 --scope global
redwood rollout monitor --wait 10m
```

mike_eng: perfect. I'll push the copy into the draft and pin the internal brief at 08:50. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary @ 2026-03-21T16:00:00Z -> v2.3.0 (5%). Status: in_progress.

deploy-bot: Deploy update: canary passed health checks -> status=success at 2026-03-21T16:20:00Z

kavita_pm: Canary green, moving to 25% now. Publishing internal blurb to #all-hands in 5m.

mike_eng: copy pushed and brief pinned at 08:50. Closing thread — will follow up in release notes page with post-rollout metrics and any regressions.
